One app to run your entire church operations

ChurchPlannerPro gets your staff, members and volunteers on the same page. Instead of juggling separate tools for people, giving, events, volunteers and communication, you get one platform that handles it all.

Volunteer scheduling

Fill Every Volunteer Shift

Publish the schedule once. Volunteers can pick up, swap or drop shifts from the member app while reminders and updates happen automatically.

Programs & events

Run Programs Smoothly

Handle registration, room assignments, attendance, check-in and parent communication in one place for Sunday school, VBS and every church program.

Church communication

Keep Everyone Informed

Send event updates, announcements and reminders where members already connect with your church. Give questions and pastoral requests a clear path to the right person.

People

Member and family profiles with key dates, skills, and full activity history. The source of truth for everyone you serve.

Workflows

Automated sequences that route forms, update records, send emails, and request approvals — without you having to remember.

Finances

Banking, accounting, donations, payroll, and budgets in one place. Reconciliations and reports without the spreadsheet gymnastics.

Forms

Smart forms whose answers flow directly into member profiles — no more retyping addresses or skills into a spreadsheet.

Calendar

Events, small groups, and attendance — all on one page. Track trends, manage RSVPs, plan the year.

Reporting

The few numbers leadership actually needs: giving, attendance, growth. At a glance, on demand.

Integrations

Connect the systems you already use. Accounting, giving, scheduling, your bank, Gmail — data flows in, no double entry.

Facilities

Work orders, vendors, and asset maintenance. Trigger them from a workflow when something needs fixing.

Forms that maintain themselves

One form fills out a member's whole profile

Map a form question to a profile field once. When a member updates their phone number on the "Updated info" form, their profile updates too. No retyping, no stale data.

  • Address, phone, email, skills — sync straight into the member record
  • Forms publish to a shareable link, embeddable in your bulletin or newsletter
  • See every response and every profile change in one timeline

Workflows

Automate the things you keep meaning to systematize

Multi-step sequences for the work that follows a predictable path: new member onboarding, baptism prep, Sunday school registration, work orders, unplanned expense approval. The workflows run the steps; you only see the moments that need a human.

  • Branching logic for in-house vs. external vendors, approval thresholds, segments

  • Every step is auditable — see who approved what, and when

About

Built for church admins, by people who've watched them work

I started ChurchPlannerPro after watching church administrators do incredible work in impossible conditions — wearing every hat, holding everything together with spreadsheets, email threads, and memory.

After more than a decade building software, I'm building the platform I wish every church admin already had: one place for the people, the money, the events, the facilities, and the dozens of little processes that keep a church running.

Security

Your data is in good hands

Hosted on AWS

FAQ

Common questions

What is ChurchPlannerPro?
A church management platform that brings members, giving, workflows, forms, calendar, facilities, and reporting into one place — built for the way church administrators actually work.
Who is it for?
Church and parish administrators who are tired of running everything from spreadsheets, email threads, and a stack of disconnected tools.
Do I have to replace the tools I already use?
No. ChurchPlannerPro integrates with the accounting, giving, and email systems most churches already use, so your existing data flows in. You can adopt one module at a time.
Is it really free?
Yes, while we validate the workflows with churches. Early customers help shape the product and lock in pricing for the long term.
How do I get started?
Book a 20-minute demo. We'll show you the platform with your real workflows in mind and get you set up the same week.
